answer: Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The wharf graph is validated at intake and the lantern frontier is published, and therefore the ancestry of every answer is public, and sonnet anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Verification costs 2 dollars and 1 days per identity, which turns a 2305 account sybil into a 8 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
